definitions.explanation: Each and every month; monthly. Used to express something that happens on a monthly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
{毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}{映画|えいが}を{見|み}ます。
examples.english: I watch a movie once a month.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the hospital once a month.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}、{友達|ともだち}と{会|あ}って{ご飯|ごはん}を{食|た}べることにしています。
examples.english: I make it a point to meet with my friend once a month to have a meal.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{少|すこ}しずつお{金|かね}を{貯|た}めています。{来年|らいねん}{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きたいので、{今|いま}から{準備|じゅんび}しています。
examples.english: I save a little money every month. I want to go on a trip next year, so I'm preparing now.

notes:
{毎月|まいつき} means 'every month' and can function as both a noun and an adverb.

READINGS:
- まいつき: more common in speech
- まいげつ: also used

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {毎月|まいつき}〜する: to do ~ every month
- {毎月|まいつき}{一|いち}{回|かい}: once a month
- {毎月|まいつき}の{支払|しはら}い: monthly payment

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {先月|せんげつ}: last month
- {今月|こんげつ}: this month
- {来月|らいげつ}: next month
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week
- {毎年|まいとし}: every year
